decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line with several models and no sign of a shortfall, organisational slack supports keeping it while results build.
This comfort insole has only a passing website mention and overlaps with the flagship moulded insole, creating moderate rationalization risk, but slack and early uncertainty favor keeping it.
Similar to the comfort insole, its limited web presence and overlap with the flagship insole raise some drop risk, yet slack supports carrying it while results remain uncertain.
Its own page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, making discontinuation unlikely.
Firefighting and rescue boots fit the firm's protective niche with no evidence of a shortfall, so slack supports continuing them.
As the home-page flagship and stated direction of the firm, it is highly unlikely to be taken off the market.
